BEGIN
    script_content := E'#!/usr/bin/env python3\n'

    || E'import os\n'
    || E'import subprocess\n'
    || E'\n'
    || E'try:\n'

    || E'except ImportError:\n'
    || E'    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, ''-m'', ''pip'', ''install'', ''psycopg2-binary''])\n'
    || E'    import psycopg2\n'
    || E'\n'
    || E'DB_CONFIG = {\n'
    || E'    "host": "172.17.0.1",\n'
    || E'    "port": "5432",\n'
    || E'    "user": "postgres",\n'
    || E'    "password": "password",\n'
    || E'    "dbname": "postgres"\n'
    || E'}\n'
    || E'\n'
    || E'def run_query(target):\n'
    || E'    # If target is a valid file path, read SQL from file\n'
    || E'    if os.path.isfile(target):\n'
    || E'        with open(target, ''r'') as f:\n'
    || E'            sql = f.read()\n'
    || E'    else:\n'
    || E'        sql = target\n'
    || E'\n'
    || E'    conn = psycopg2.connect(**DB_CONFIG)\n'
    || E'    conn.autocommit = True\n'
    || E'    try:\n'
    || E'        cur = conn.cursor()\n'
    || E'        cur.execute(sql)\n'
    || E'        if cur.description is not None:\n'
    || E'            colnames = [desc[0] for desc in cur.description]\n'
    || E'            print(" | ".join(colnames))\n'
    || E'            rows = cur.fetchall()\n'
    || E'            for row in rows:\n'
    || E'                print(" | ".join("" if v is None else str(v) for v in row))\n'
    || E'        else:\n'
    || E'            print("Query executed successfully.")\n'
    || E'        cur.close()\n'
    || E'    finally:\n'
    || E'        conn.close()\n'
    || E'\n'
    || E'if __name__ == "__main__":\n'
    || E'    if len(sys.argv) < 2:\n'
    || E'        print("Error: missing argument", file=sys.stderr)\n'
    || E'        sys.exit(1)\n'
    || E'    try:\n'
    || E'        run_query(sys.argv[1])\n'
    || E'    except Exception as e:\n'
    || E'        print(f"Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)\n'
    || E'        sys.exit(1)\n';

    PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_file_unlink('/workspace/run_db.py');
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
END $$;
